name: tensor-midi
description: Treats fleet conversations as jazz performances captured in MIDI, viewable as a DAW/mixer-board, and overlaid on a nautical chart.

scripts.analyze: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const {JazzAnalyzer}=require('./analysis/jazz-analyzer'); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2],'utf8')); const analyzer=new JazzAnalyzer(data); console.log(analyzer.generateLeadSheet());"

author: Casey DiGennaro
